title: We farm, source, pack and export fresh fish from Egypt
p1: At AZAFCO International we farm our own fish and buy from suppliers, then grade and pack them for our business customers, with a packing capacity of up to 2,500 t/month.
p2: Since 2008 we have shipped fresh chilled fish to importers, distributors and foodservice buyers; today we pack at our plant in Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh.
